2607.21300.title: Unlearning Under Imbalance: Benchmarking Fairness in Multimodal LLM Unlearning
2607.21300.paper_summary: Machine unlearning has emerged as a tool for removing personal data from trained models to comply with recent AI regulations. To evaluate unlearning effectiveness in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), prior works fine-tune models on fictitious identities, simulating unlearning requests on subsets of these IDs, which are typically uniformly distributed. However, in realistic scenarios, people from different demographic groups may request to be unlearned at different frequencies, potentially altering the model's internal beliefs for these groups and leading to biased behaviors. To fill this gap, we propose FAIRGET, the first Visual Question Answering benchmark that evaluates unlearning under unbalanced, realistic, forget requests. These requests are designed to simulate multiple realistic scenarios, ranging from simple to challenging settings, that lead to biased unlearned models if fairness is not accounted for. Additionally, we propose FAUN, the first unlearning algorithm for MLLMs that forgets unlearning data while preserving model fairness. FAUN exploits a bias-aware activation steering mechanism to unlearn identities while accounting for the unbalanced nature of the forget data. Experiments on FAIRGET and the established FIUBench demonstrate our method's superiority both in unlearning quality and fairness.
2607.21300.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘已成為一種工具，用於從訓練模型中移除個人數據，以遵循近期的人工智慧法規。<lb/>為了評估多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）中的遺忘效果，先前的工作對模型進行微調，使用虛構身份模擬對這些身份子集的遺忘請求，這些身份通常是均勻分佈的。<lb/>然而，在現實情況下，來自不同人口群體的人可能會以不同的頻率請求被遺忘，這可能會改變模型對這些群體的內部信念，並導致偏見行為。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們提出了FAIRGET，第一個在不平衡、現實的遺忘請求下評估遺忘的視覺問答基準。<lb/>這些請求旨在模擬多種現實情境，從簡單到具有挑戰性的設置，如果不考慮公平性，將導致偏見的未學習模型。<lb/>此外，我們提出了FAUN，第一個針對MLLMs的遺忘算法，能在保留模型公平性的同時遺忘遺忘數據。<lb/>FAUN利用一種偏見感知的激活引導機制，在考慮遺忘數據的不平衡特性時遺忘身份。<lb/>在FAIRGET和已建立的FIUBench上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在遺忘質量和公平性方面均優於其他方法。
